question: Does the four-cluster coherent-core/twisted-outskirts sign rule predict RX J2129's physical-tensor response?
interpretation: new data-channel transfer to a globally spent cluster; not untouched project validation

sign_gate.inner_threshold_source: midpoint between P0564 MACS0429 value 0.505048 and positive-group maximum 0.150719
sign_gate.outer_threshold_source: midpoint between P0564 MACS0429 value -0.491632 and positive-group minimum 0.640433
sign_gate.rule: t=-0.3 only if inner correlation exceeds its threshold AND outer cos2 alignment is below its threshold; otherwise t=+0.3

claim_limits: RX J2129 is globally spent in earlier project work, although its P0564 descriptors and this tensor response were not used to derive the gate.
